{{figure:fig_3_1.webp}}

The diagram shows the graph of the probability density function, $\text{f}$, of a random variable $X$ that takes values between $x = 0$ and $x = 3$ only. The graph is symmetrical about the line $x = 1.5$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
It is given that $\text{P}(X < 0.6) = a$ and $\text{P}(0.6 < X < 1.2) = b$.

Find $\text{P}(0.6 < X < 1.8)$ in terms of $a$ and $b$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
It is now given that the equation of the probability density function of $X$ is

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} kx^2(3 - x)^2 & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 3, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.
